verses.1: To destroy the children of Korach, Makshil.
verses.2: God, in our ears, we have heard from our ancestors how He acted in their days, in ancient times.
verses.3: You, with your hands, you have inherited nations; you have caused them to suffer and to be destroyed. You have sent them away.
verses.4: For they did not choose the land to inherit, nor did their descendants receive any relief from you. As it is written in your words: “Your face will be exalted, and your eyes will shine.” For you desired this.
verses.5: You are the king of God; you command that Jacob be saved.
verses.6: In you we seek refuge; in your name we rise up.
verses.7: For I have not asked for a guarantee, and your destruction will not save me.
verses.8: For You have saved us from our troubles and from the contempt of those who despise us.
verses.9: To God, we praise you every day. Your name will be remembered forever.
verses.10: You have abandoned us and despised us; you will never be able to enter our houses.
verses.11: Let us be reconciled with one another, and let us not hate each other anymore.
verses.12: Give us food like sheep, and in the nations, we will be a blessing.
verses.13: You have taken your people without paying any price, and you have not charged them any price at all.
verses.14: Let us bring shame upon our neighbors, as a source of ridicule and humiliation for those around us.
verses.15: Let us be rulers over the nations, with authority over their leaders.
verses.16: Today, in my heart, I am against it; my face is covered with shame.
verses.17: From a harsh and angry voice, from the side of the enemy, and from those who are being purified.
verses.18: All of this we have given you. We have not forgotten about you, nor have we broken our covenant with you.
verses.19: I will not try again to deceive us; we have been deceived by you from the beginning.
verses.20: For you have placed us in a place of darkness, and you have covered us with your shadow.
verses.21: If we forget the name of our God, and turn our faces towards other gods.
verses.22: But God will investigate this, for He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.23: Since you killed us today, we are considered like sheep that have been slaughtered.
verses.24: Why do you sleep, O Lord? Do not abandon us forever.
verses.25: Why do you hide your face from us? Why do you forget about our suffering and hardships?
verses.26: For our souls have sunk into the abyss; they are bound to the earth by their very bodies.
verses.27: May You help us and save us, for Your kindness.
